issue_context.title: Use-after-free bug on StatsPluginChannelScope
issue_context.body: There's an ASAN issue on the usage of `StatsPluginChannelScope` as shown in https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-cpp/pull/14259/checks?check_run_id=25119432817
comments: Needs to be backported to 1.63 and 1.64 as well

review_comments:
Suggest writing this as:

```
std::string authority =
    args.GetOwnedString(GRPC_ARG_DEFAULT_AUTHORITY)
                    .value_or(CoreConfiguration::Get()
                                  .resolver_registry()
                                  .GetDefaultAuthority(target);
*(*r)->stats_plugin_group =
    GlobalStatsPluginRegistry::GetStatsPluginsForChannel(
        experimental::StatsPluginChannelScope(target, authority));
```
